articles.title: Newcastle United Chiefs Break Silence On Jaissle: Can He Fix The Leaky Defence?
articles.summary: Four goals conceded. Again. Newcastle United fans left Coventry on Monday night with sore feet, sorer heads and one question rattling around: is this already...
articles.body:
Four goals conceded. Again. Newcastle United fans left Coventry on Monday night with sore feet, sorer heads and one question rattling around: is this already getting out of hand?

You'd think so. Matthias Jaissle apologised to the travelling fans after the 4-1 loss, and the numbers look like a bad dream, because Newcastle had 19 shots, two-thirds of the ball and still walked off beaten.

Defending, mostly. Jack Rudoni's penalty and Sidiki Cherif's early second-half strike left a mountain to climb, Sven Botman's screamer gave brief hope, and Ellis Simms and Stephen Mfuni finished the job.

That's 13 goals conceded, joint-worst in the league, and Leeds had already hammered them 4-1 at Elland Road. Jamie Carragher told Sky Sports they were "beaten up" again.

Not according to the Daily Mai l. Craig Hope reported on 14 October that the mood is calm, with no shows of support for Jaissle and no emergency talks among the top brass. Training is "business as usual" before Aston Villa on Saturday.

Eight points from six games leaves Newcastle 11th. Not a disaster, not a party either. Crystal Palace away and two Everton games in five days follow Villa.

Craig Hope wrote: "The mood inside the club has been one of calm in the wake of the defeat at Coventry, a second 4-1 reverse on the spin away from home. There has not, we understand, been any need for shows of support for Jaissle or conversations among the top brass."

Can Jaissle fix Newcastle's leaky defence quickly?

COVENTRY, ENGLAND – OCTOBER 12: Matthias Jaissle, Manager of Newcastle United, looks on after the Premier League 2026/27 match between Coventry City and Newcastle United at The Coventry Building Society Arena on October 12, 2026 in Coventry, England. (Photo by Dan Istitene/Getty Images)

If I'm Jaissle, I start with how we lose the ball, not how we score. Possession of 66.7 per cent tells me the shape in attack works. The damage comes in transition, and the Simms goal, born from a loose pass near our own box, shows the risk in playing out from the back while opponents press. I'd simplify those moments straight away.

Midfield worries me too. Opponents keep running through the middle, and Yoane Wissa struggled as a number 10 at Coventry. I'd move him closer to goal and give Nico González and Lewis Miley a clearer protective job.

Carragher's physicality point stings, yet I'd answer it with shape and set-piece drills, because Cherif's goal followed a long throw we couldn't clear. Hall and Joelinton were caught in possession for Simms's goal, so I'd tell both to clear their lines when pressed, not dribble out.

Villa at St James' Park gives me a crowd and a chance to win ugly. A tidy 1-0 beats another open shootout. The board's calm buys me time, but eight goals in two away games won't keep buying it.

articles.title: What was the most damaging loss from the chaotic college football weekend?
articles.summary: Of all this upsets this weekend, none is bigger than Florida over Texas, which leaves the Longhorns reeling.
articles.body:
There was a time when a Week 7 loss would mean the end of a program's championship hopes, that ugly "1" on the second half of their record more than enough to block any path forward. Those days are long gone, of course, and by the time the 24-team playoff rolls around, a regular-season loss won't even dent the hopes of top programs. Which is too bad, really; the regular season's importance continues to dwindle.

Thing is, even in a watered-down era, losses don't just leave a mark on your record. The worst can leave a mark on your soul, staining the entire perception of a program, injecting doubt into the locker room and the stands. Long after the last warm days of October are a memory, some of these losses are going to haunt teams deep into December and beyond. Let's run down seven Week 7 losses from least to most damaging:

7. Indiana to Ohio State : Annoying but manageable

Not an upset, but any time the undefeated No. 5 team and defending national champ loses, it's notable. Just under a year ago, Indiana beat Penn State on a miraculous, last-minute, toe-tap touchdown. On Saturday, Indiana lost to Ohio State because of an almost-miraculous, last-second, toe-tap near-touchdown. When you lose to a fellow top-10 team by half the width of a shoe, well, it's painful but not disastrous. Indiana will be just fine … unless the Hoosiers start thinking that the football gods that smiled on them in 2025 have forsaken them in 2026. (And Ohio State might have won the game, but the loss of Julian Sayin for the short term could make this a costly victory indeed.)

Memphis was an outside pick to make the CFP, but its road there is now effectively nonexistent after a second loss on the season and a first in the American conference. Any school outside the Power 4 has a hair-thin margin for error even in the best-case scenario, and Memphis is not living a best-case scenario.

5. Oklahoma State to Houston: Momentum buster

This is one that would be worse in the 24-team playoff era, but since it's an uphill road for either of these two to even make the playoff, this is a pride loss more than a postseason-projection one. Drew Mestemaker threw for 359 yards and three touchdowns, so his dark-horse Heisman campaign remains on track.

4. Georgia to Auburn : Mostly irrelevant

Probably more damaging for Dawg tailgaters, who had to make an unfamiliar walk of pain back to their SUVs. Georgia hadn't lost a game at Sanford Stadium since 2019, meaning three entire classes of students never saw a loss at home. Poor babies. Anyway, this will have no meaningful impact on Georgia's playoff hopes, but does introduce doubt about Gunner Stockton (three turnovers, including a crucial game-flipping fumble). Unlike the three upsets above it, Georgia can obliterate the memory of this loss by hitting its next couple SEC opponents with some vintage three-possession winning margins.

3. Notre Dame to BYU : Potentially problematic

Rough for the Irish, not only because it feeds into the ongoing perception that Notre Dame flails whenever it plays a respectable team, but because the Irish still have Miami on the schedule. Losing to the No. 8 team isn't inherently dishonorable, particularly when missing out on a potential game-winning play. But when playoff rankings come around, critics point white-hot spotlights at any blemish on Notre Dame's record — not without reason — and this obviously qualifies. A second could eliminate them from the postseason.

2. Alabama to Tennessee : Deeply damaging

This is one of those leave-a-bruise losses. The fact of Tennessee beating Alabama isn't that big a deal in itself; the Vols have now won the last three Third Saturdays in October played in Knoxville. But Tennessee has reignited all those doubts about Alabama and Kalen DeBoer, particularly in road games. Keelon Russell looked mortal, the Alabama defense crumbled after a solid start, and the team as a whole looked overmatched. After starting the year strong, DeBoer and the Tide are right back in prove-it territory.

Texas has underachieved for years, and Saturday seemed like the culmination of decades of big talk and small action. Unable to move the ball against Florida's generally woeful defense, unable to shut down a quarterback making his first college football start, unable once again to live up to its high preseason expectations, Texas is now in existential trouble. They pretty much need to win the national championship at this point to get out from under this cloud of doubt and disappointment they've generated over themselves.

articles.title: Radu: “Hemos sufrido hasta el final, pero el equipo está creciendo”
articles.standfirst: El meta firmó una actuación espectacular en el encuentro ante el Alavés
articles.summary: El meta firmó una actuación espectacular en el encuentro ante el Alavés
articles.body: Radu firmó una actuación sobresaliente ante el Alavés, sacando dos manos prodigiosas para que el Celta sumase una nueva victoria. Un rendimiento que certifica el gran inicio de temporada del meta rumano, que lo juega todo. Tocó sufrir: “Parecía que era un partido ganado antes de los últimos minutos, pero en el fútbol nunca puedes esperar algo seguro. Hemos sufrido hasta el final, hemos luchado y los tres puntos se han quedado en casa que era muy importante y fundamental”. El equipo crece: “He visto al equipo muy bien. Está creciendo, tenemos que encontrar más rápido el equilibrio en los partidos y empezar con las ganas que tuvimos en el segundo tiempo. Eso nos llevará a conseguir más victorias y puntos”. Pasa página y ya se centra en el Celtic: “Tenemos que afrontar cada partido con las mismas ganas y calma. Tenemos que disfrutar, al final el fútbol es eso, y solo así se pueden obtener resultados, siendo libres mentalmente. Tenemos que darle las gracias a la afición que siempre nos comprende y sostiene”.

articles.title: Arsenal grinding out wins with fewer goals, flair: 'Extra belief' after title, concerning, or both?
articles.summary: Sunday's hero Noni Madueke said Arsenal is just different when they're not at their best this season, signaling superiority and bidding to fill anyone's half...
articles.body:
Arsenal won the Premier League title and improved their team in a manner that had many — this writer included — tabbing them to win the league in more comfortable fashion than the last.

The Gunners, of course, are still in the discussion but have not been at their domestic best since just before the international break. A team that authored 19 goals off corner kicks last season have yet to find one this season, so you know something's wrong.

Jokes aside, the Gunners have bounced back from their unceremonious hammering at Brighton. Yet their attacking edge looked rather dull in a 2-1 win over Leeds and a 1-0 win Sunday at Nottingham Forest.

Sunday's hero Noni Madueke said the team is just different when they're not at their best this season, signaling superiority and bidding to fill anyone's half-empty cup.

"At times maybe last year this game might've gone different in the end but we have that extra belief," Madueke said. "We know we are the champions and we can pull that out of the bag when we need it."

That's not a bad thing at all. Yet something in the sauce isn't looking right on the stove despite the Gunners feasting to the tune of 18 points from 21.

Arteta's men would've been forgiven if defending was at the heart of these mild and relative struggles given William Saliba's still yet to make a season debut, but it's the attack that is troublesome at the moment.

Are we just judging Arsenal through a new lens, or is something not yet right with the Gunners? Maybe both.

Arsenal's season so far: What's different?

The Gunners are 6-0-1, claiming all but three points while scoring 11 times and conceding just six. xG says they've been a bit unlucky in attack and perhaps a bit fortunate at the back, while conceding too many shots in open play.

It's a small sample size but Arsenal's numbers are down through seven games (six in some metrics due to the Week 7 game just ending). Arsenal have played the 3rd, 4th, 7th, 12th, 16th, 18th, and 19th place teams on the table so far, not a murderers row.

Let's start with goals and expected goals.

First 7 matches of 2026-27 vs last season

xG/game: 1.82 (down from 2.04) xGA/game: 1.05 (up from 0.87) G/game: 1.57 (down from 1.87) GA/game : 0.85 (up from 0.71)

These difference are enough to be notable but don't have to be represent actual alarm. It could be as simple as some personnel changes and how new pieces fill their roles. Christos Tzolis has looked good but missed a couple of games as the Gunners are replacing non-stars who knew their roles in Leandro Trossard and Gabriel Martinelli. Myles Lewis-Skelly has largely been replacing Martin Zubimendi and is younger, so Arteta is taking mild hits for longer-term rewards, while Saliba's absence is a big deal.

As for some other stats, we cannot yet adjust for the Forest game but...

First six matches of 2026-27 vs last season

Open play shots/game: 9.83 (down from 10.39) Open play shots against/game: 6.67 (up from 6.31) Corner kicks: 2.16 (down from 2.89)

This is another argument for luck and sample size, as the Gunners are also yet to score from a corner kick after scoring every other game from one last season (19 total goals).

Arsenal are getting backed down more often this season, and the above numbers don't yet account for Forest's stodgy, stubborn play behind the ball on Sunday.

Arsenal's 12-day stretch to speak volumes

The above numbers could echo as blips, ghost notes, or alarm bells once Arsenal's next four games are in the book.

They head to Bayern Munich on Wednesday for a massive Champions League encounter, then welcome top-four hopefuls Arsenal to the Emirates in the Premier League on Saturday.

A trip to Fleetwood Town in the League Cup on October 27 will serve as an appetizer for a trip to Liverpool at Anfield in the league on November 1.

The Gunners will face four very different challenges. Bayern will test their defense as well as anyone they've met outside of Chelsea, who were in the very early days of Xabi Alonso's management when they met in North London.

Everton have been feisty with and without the ball. Fleetwood will almost absolutely park their bus, and Liverpool's Liverpool.

The Gunners have taken 18-of-21 points, better than last season's 5-1-1 start. But that championship start also included trips to Liverpool, Arsenal, Manchester United, and Newcastle. There's no question we've yet to see the best of Arsenal or even the 7.5 out of 10 version of Arsenal. The fact that they've only dropped points once may well be a sign of championship mettle and real valor. It might include a good helping of good fortune, too. As Arteta often says after questions about his team, "So let's see."

articles.title: "Arrogant" Sunderland struggling in Premier League but what is wrong with Black Cats?
articles.summary: Sunderland defender Nordi Mukiele suggested the Black Cats may have become "arrogant" as last season's surprise package stutter in the Premier League this term.
articles.body:
Nordi Mukiele offered a brutally honest verdict about why Sunderland have struggled so far this season, following their impressive return to the Premier League last term.

The Black Cats defender had his say after a 2-0 defeat by Bournemouth on Sunday. It was Sunderland 's fourth Premier League loss in a row and leaves them second bottom in the table.

Only those inside the club can answer Mukiele's "arrogant" claim after the Black Cats' drop-off in results and performance.

They surprised everyone last season by qualifying for the Europa League at the first time of asking after eight years away from the top flight.

But have Sunderland been found out by their rivals? Are they suffering the somewhat mythical second season syndrome? Or might they simply be struggling with the added demands of European football?

"I think this game is just what we are looking [like] from the beginning of the season," Mukiele told Sky Sports. "We are not good enough.

"Why? I don't know. Maybe because we became arrogant, this is what I think."

Sunderland head coach Regis le Bris was not quite as damning but still disappointed.

"We were below the level, it's really clear. It's hard to take, hard to digest," Le Bris told Sky Sports.

"It's very painful because we were not Sunderland and it's not acceptable."

Is European competition hurting league form?

After seven games last season, Sunderland had 11 points and were ninth in the table having won three, drawn two and lost two.

At the same point this term, they have four points with one win, a draw and five defeats.

"We won't find excuses," said Le Bris. "We have a busy schedule. We want to embrace the challenge, but the position at the minute is not good."

Sunderland 's league form so far points to a relegation battle, but in Europe they have a 100% record after wins over Dutch side AZ Alkmaar and second-tier Portuguese outfit Torreense.

They have now lost both games in the immediate aftermath of their Europa League outings, although one of those was an eight-goal thriller against unbeaten league leaders Manchester City.

Former Newcastle United goalkeeper Shay Given – who had a loan spell at Sunderland in 1996 while a Blackburn Rovers player – believes the Black Cats' squad may be not sufficiently set up to deal with the extra games after last season's seventh-placed finish.

He does see a route out of relegation danger, though.

"They overachieved last season, getting into European competition," said Given.

"I don't know if the squad is ready for a challenge on all fronts. You need a bigger squad, a deeper squad, and it's going to be a big ask. I'm just looking at the table and they're second bottom at the minute.

"I know it's only seven games played, but there are so many games coming up and in a short period of time. It's about the bread and butter in the Premier League - that's the most important thing. You like to think with Le Bris, they'll have enough to be safe."

Sunderland spent £161m on 15 new players after gaining promotion to the Premier League in the summer of 2025.

In the transfer window this summer, they invested about £60m on five new recruits but their success was probably more in keeping key players such as captain Granit Xhaka and striker Brian Brobbey, who is currently out with a hamstring injury.

Whether or not Sunderland 's squad is deep enough, heading to Bournemouth to face a side who were without a league win before Sunday and had also just played in Europe on Thursday should have been one they were relishing.

Yet Sunderland could not have made it easier for the hosts at Vitality Stadium.

One of the recent summer recruits, Kevin Danso – a loan signing from Tottenham Hotspur - was bullied by Evanilson in the build-up to Marcus Tavernier's opener in just the sixth minute.

Centre-back Danso was then sent off in the 17th minute for dragging down the Brazilian striker when he was clear through on goal.

In the second half, Omar Alderete's weak backpass to goalkeeper Robin Roefs gifted Evanilson the chance to secure the three points for the Cherries.

According to Opta, in the Premier League this season no side has committed more errors leading to goals than Sunderland with five.

Alderete also became just the third player to commit multiple errors leading to goals this season, alongside team-mate Danso and Hull 's Konstantinos Tzolakis.

Sunderland have also conceded 14 goals - only Crystal Palace and Ipswich Town have shipped more - which is more than double their goals-against tally after seven games last season.

They have only scored six, and their three attempted shots in Sunday's game – all off target - represented the lowest total for any team in a Premier League match this season.

It should be noted they have faced Manchester City , champions Arsenal and in-form Brighton , so it has not been an easy start.

"It's just the beginning. Football is like this," said Mukiele. "You can accept and just stand up and go back to work. If I believe we can go back to the top again, yeah, I believe about this.

"It depends about what we really want and this starts in training because we don't do enough and after you can see it on the pitch.

"You cannot lie about football and today I don't want to say we didn't want to win this game, but it didn't look like we want something.

"We just have to work hard to be back where we were like last season because right now this is not us - this is not Sunderland ."

articles.title: Reconciliación con exhibición y doblete
articles.standfirst: Oyarzabal, que se echó una vez más al equipo a su espalda cuando el Málaga acortó distancia, marcó sus primeros dos tantos tras 10 partidos 'peleado' con el gol
articles.summary: El capitán txuriurdin se echó una vez más al equipo a su espalda cuando el Málaga acortó distancia en la segunda parte, para marcar dos goles y devolver la tranquilidad
articles.body: Mikel Oyarzabal volvió a ser titular en La Rosaleda, pese a los muchos cambios que introdujo Pellegrino Matarazzo en su alineación inicial, al continuar con las rotaciones que hace por la acumulación de partidos, hasta cinco en sólo 15 días, y el campeón del Mundo aprovechó mantenerse una vez más entre los elegidos para reencontrarse con el gol de txuriurdin, además por partida doble. Tras 10 encuentros 'peleado' por no acertar, selló una muy feliz reconciliación. Oyarzabal, como cabía esperar, fue por novena vez en los 11 encuentros disputados hasta la fecha de la partida, pese a que venía de disputar 92 minutos el jueves en Bélgica y llevar a cabo Matarazzo hasta 7 variaciones con esa cita: Remiro, Fort, Aihen, Soler, Kubo, Barrenetxea y Óskarsson. El 10, que no había marcado en esa decena de partidos anteriores, seguro que sintió algo de envidia cuando su compañero Take Kubo, que como él tampoco se había estrenado de txuriurdin este curso, celebró una diana propia cuando se llevaban sólo tres minutos de juego, con Óskarsson haciendo el segundo antes del descanso. El campeón del Mundo no iba a tener en la segunda parte piedad del equipo y la afición que antes del pitido inicial le homenajearon por ese enorme éxito, porque tras el 1-2 hizo el 1-3, que celebró con rabia por ese reencuentro ansiado con el gol, y después del 2-3 firmó un doblete para devolver la tranquilidad a su equipo, que terminó imponiéndose con comodidad, al marcar Guedes el quinto. Oyarzabal, como apuntamos hace unos días en MARCA, había tenido en temporadas anteriores otras malas rachas goleadoras incluso más largas que la actual, pero siempre terminaba marcando, como lo hizo en La Rosaleda, donde sumó los tantos número 134 y 135 de su carrera con una Real con la que aspira, entre otras cosas, a ser el máximo realizador de su historia, superando los 162 de la leyenda Jesús Satrustegui, el único que le queda por delante.

articles.title: Cánticos en el Bernabéu de "¡Tebas dimisión!", "¡Laporta sigue pagando!" y "¡Negreira sigue pitando!"
articles.standfirst: La grada de animación cargó durante seis minutos desde el pitido inicial contra el mandatario de LaLiga, el 'caso Negreira', la Federación y el presidente del Barcelona
articles.summary: La grada de animación cargó durante seis minutos desde el pitido inicial contra el mandatario de LaLiga, el 'caso Negreira', la Federación y el presidente del Barcelona
articles.body: Desde el pitido inicial y durante unos seis minutos de forma continuada, la grada de animación del Bernabéu dedicó cánticos contra Tebas, la Federación, el 'caso Negreira' y Laporta. "¡Tebas dimisión!", "¡Las manos de Tebas fuera del Madrid!", "¡Laporta sigue pagando!", "¡Negreira sigue pitando!" y "¡Corrupción en la Federación!" fueron los cánticos que se escucharon en el Bernabéu durante el inicio del encuentro. Además, se mostró una pancarta en el fondo sur del estadio que rezaba: "No es fútbol, es Tebas y Negreira" (con los colores azulgrana en Tebas y Negreira). La enésima confrontación entre el Real Madrid y Javier Tebas, una de las más ásperas que han protagonizado, estalló el pasado viernes y ha calentado los ánimos en el Bernabéu. Un polémico tuit del presidente de LaLiga y vicepresidente de la RFEF, en el que comparaba la estrategia comunicativa de Real Madrid Televisión con los métodos de propaganda nazi de Joseph Goebbels, desató las hostilidades. La acusación del dirigente provocó la reacción del club blanco, que en un durísimo comunicado pocas horas después calificaba de "absolutamente intolerable y de extraordinaria gravedad" las manifestaciones de Tebas y exigía su "dimisión inmediata" como presidente de LaLiga y vicepresidente de la Real Federación Española de Fútbol. Pero todo esto sólo fue el principio de un largo enfrentamiento que acumuló capítulos. El primero, la respuesta de Tebas en otro largo tuit a la petición de su dimisión del Real Madrid. "Todo esto tiene un nombre: intimidación", apuntaba el dirigente. Con la 'guerra' Madrid-Tebas recrudeciéndose, se sumó a ella ni más ni menos que el Consejo Superior de Deportes. Según informó Efe, el CSD estaba estudiando actuar de oficio ante las manifestaciones de Javier Tebas, una noticia a la que también respondió el dirigente. "No doy crédito a la noticia", apuntaba. El pulso iba sumando participantes. Y no unos cualquiera. Primero Mourinho, en defensa del Madrid, y luego Laporta, en defensa de Tebas. "Ha entrado en un campo que solo tiene disculpas si es un caso clínico. El madridismo entiende a lo que el Madrid se enfrenta", era el mensaje envenenado del técnico. Por su parte, el presidente del Barça, Laporta, como no podía ser de otra manera, se posicionó del lado del presidente de LaLiga: "Suerte que Javier Tebas está curtido en estas batallas y no se deja amedrentar por esta actitud del Real Madrid, que parece que quieran reventarlo todo". Este domingo fue el Bernabéu el que entró en la 'guerra'.

images.caption: La pancarta que se mostró en el Bernabéu contra Tebas y el Barcelona.

articles.title: Pierre Sage apologises to Crystal Palace fans after the Eagles are thrashed by Brighton
articles.summary: Crystal Palace manage Pierre Sage says he feels "shame" at the Eagles' performance during their 5-0 thrashing by Brighton and does not know if he will be given time to save his job.
articles.body:
Crystal Palace manager Pierre Sage said he felt "shame" at the Eagles' performance during their 5-0 thrashing by Brighton and did not know whether he would be given time to save his job.

Sage's side conceded three times in the opening 10 minutes as they suffered their worst loss to their rivals since January 1956.

"It's my fault because I am the coach, I gave the motivation. I prepare the situations. We played so bad it's my fault," said Frenchman Sage, who was only appointed Palace manager in the summer.

"It's difficult to summarise because there are a lot of negative points.

"We started really bad. It's completely not normal to concede three goals in this kind of game after nine minutes.

"I prepare the team, that is why I am responsible of what's happened on the pitch. I have a lot of work to do because I have to change this kind of thing."

Asked if he will get time to turn Palace's poor form around, he said: "I don't know."

Under his predecessor Oliver Glasner, Palace enjoyed the most successful phase in the club's history, lifting the FA Cup for the first time in 2025 and then winning the Conference League in May.

But Sage has had a tough start at Selhurst Park since he arrived after guiding Lens to the French Cup and second in Ligue 1 last season.

Palace are 14th in the Premier League with two wins from seven games but their 17 goals conceded are the most in the top flight.

"I just want to apologise to the fans," added Sage. "We were not at the level we expected, and I'm really sorry for that because I know how important it is for them, but we didn't show today that it's really important for us too."

Asked on his emotions after the game, he replied: "Only one feeling - shame. When you play this kind of game you have to show another face. It was our worst face."

Palace, with one win and one loss from their two Europa League matches, play on Thursday with a trip to Turkey to take on Besiktas before returning to Premier League action on Sunday at home to Newcastle .

articles.title: Arda Güler, del susto al golazo
articles.standfirst: El turco abrió el marcador a las mil maravillas minutos después de un forcejeo con Peque que pudo acabar con castigo para el madridista
articles.summary: El turco abrió el marcador a las mil maravillas minutos después de un forcejeo con Peque que pudo acabar con castigo para el madridista
articles.body: Estaba siendo una tímida primera parte en el Santiago Bernabéu. Los espectadores del Real Madrid - Sevilla apenas vieron un par de acercamientos y la aireada protesta del fondo sur contra Tebas y la Federación durante el primer tramo de encuentro. Fue otra individualidad la que cambió el rumbo del partido. Un destello de Arda Güler abrió boca para los allí presentes allá por el minuto 30. Bellingham abrió para Diomande y este se la dio al turco cerca del balcón del área para que soltara un disparo de primeras con zurda a palo cambiado. Vlachodimos solo pudo estirarse ante tremendo golazo. Era el 1-0, pero minutos antes tuvo lugar la primera acción polémica del partido. Peque fue agarrando a Güler durante metros en carrera y el jugador del Madrid se intentó zafar de él en dos ocasiones, siendo la última en la que terminó sacando el brazo de una forma bastante ostensible contra el sevillista. Peque cayó al suelo inmediatamente y se quejó de un codazo en la cara. Huijsen fue el que acudió a levantarle, convencido de que Peque estaba exagerando su caída. El central se llevó la amarilla por parte del colegiado poco antes de dejar zanjada la jugada en un forcejeo sin mayor importancia. Por otro lado, las repeticiones en directo tampoco ofrecieron mayor detalle de la acción. Polémicas aparte, Güler volvió a comandar la medular del Real Madrid. Con José Mourinho todavía no había iniciado en el doble pivote, un lugar que ya habitó con la llegada de Xabi Alonso. Además, estaba siendo una semana en la que al turco se le reclamaba más cerca de la base para tener más influencia en el juego del Real Madrid. Con la llegada de Arda ahí, fue Valverde a quien le tocó desplazar su posición. El uruguayo regresó al lateral derecho, donde acabó el partido de Roma y tras el que afirmó que él está para jugar "donde diga el míster".

articles.title: Madueke shows level of 'anger and conviction' to prove he is more than a finisher
articles.summary: Noni Madueke may not have the role he wants at Arsenal but his winning goal against Nottingham Forest showed why he is one of Mikel Arteta's valued players.
articles.body:
Noni Madueke may not have the starting role he wants at Arsenal, but his winning goal against Nottingham Forest showed why he is one of Mikel Arteta's valued "finishers".

The England international scored in the second half to earn Arsenal a 1-0 result and three valuable points towards their defence of the Premier League title.

Madueke has started just one top-flight game this season, the 2-1 win over Leeds that came eight days prior to their victory over Oliver Glasner's Forest on Sunday.

Arsenal 's summer was dominated by talk of their search for an elite forward, with the left wing one of the positions identified.

But after unsuccessful pursuits of superstar players such as Vinicius Jr and Julian Alvarez, the only new addition in that position was Christos Tzolis, the winger brought in to replace the outgoing Leandro Trossard.

Tzolis has started the season well and has been the first-choice winger for Arteta, meaning that Madueke and Eberechi Eze have had to be content with the majority of their minutes coming from the bench or in the Carabao Cup.

However, Tzolis is now out with a hamstring injury picked up while playing for Greece, and that has presented a chance for Madueke to show Arteta why he should be considering the former Chelsea man as much more than a finisher - the term Arteta uses for his substitutes.

Madueke did well when starting against Leeds , praised by Arteta for being the best player at the club during the international break. The Arsenal boss said the winger "grabbed it [his start] with both hands".

The England international also started on the right wing, his more natural position, against Lille in a Champions League win on Tuesday, assisting the opening goal.

Against Forest on Sunday, Madueke was introduced at half-time by Arteta and said he took the manager's instructions with him on to the pitch.

"Hang in there, stick to the gameplan, go out there and try to attack the opposition, be dangerous, be yourself and be good defensively as well," Madueke said.

He scored with a deflected shot in the 80th minute when he took on defender Daniel Munoz and cut in on his weaker right foot.

"I'd beaten him on the outside a couple of times so I thought I'll come inside and just let rip," Madueke said.

It's fair to say that the Arsenal fans have not always taken to Madueke since his move from London rivals Chelsea .

There was a 'No to Madueke' petition started when he joined the club and his performances have been criticised for being inconsistent.

But since his £48.5m arrival, Madueke has helped the club lift their first Premier League title in 22 years and played a big part as Arsenal reached the Champions League final.

Madueke scored eight goals and provided four assists in 43 appearances in all competitions last season, but questions over his end product remain.

He is one of Arsenal 's most direct players, and England manager Thomas Tuchel and his staff also rate the winger as one of the best players in one-versus-one situations.

"Noni, look at me, a smile on my face because he is a special character," Arteta said when he was asked about Madueke's character.

"It's someone that's very much loved in and around the dressing room. The way he connects, talks with people. He is just a special guy.

"I think I saw an interview where they were asking a few of our players 'who would you call if you had a problem?' And some of them said Noni, which I was surprised.

"But I think it is a massive credit and describes the type of person he is."

The 24-year-old has now put in three good performances in a row.

"He is in a good moment," Arteta said. "After the break, he is showing something else, another level of anger, another level of conviction as well as in his actions and he is becoming decisive in matches, which is what we expect from a player like him.

"He is a player that doesn't really mind left or right, but he has played many more minutes on the right side. The team needs him there at the moment and he is doing well."

Madueke scores as Arsenal win tight game at Forest

Arsenal's 'finishers' continue to get the job done

Arteta has made a big point of referring to his substitutes as "finishers" as he points to the importance of the squad.

That mentality is seeming to have the desired effect. Since the start of last season, Arsenal substitutes have contributed to 26 Premier League goals, which is more than any other side in the league.

Bruno Guimaraes scored the winner against Leeds after coming off the bench last time out in the league, while substitutes Bukayo Saka, Kai Havertz and captain Martin Odegaard played a major role in the last two goals in the win over Lille.

But Arteta is not concerned the Gunners are overly reliant on players from the bench.

"There have been other games as well that we have had to score in the first half," Arteta said.

"We have played 11 competitive matches and we won 10. We are getting a variety of ways to win in many different contexts."

Arteta said he expected few chances against a well organised Forest at the City Ground but added: "I had the belief that the moment the physical level was going to drop, the spaces would be a little bit bigger, the timing more and we would be more efficient there.

"And the finishers delivered because the context of the game changed a little bit."

articles.title: Elogios en Alemania a Luis Díaz: Kimmich destaca la exhibición y la prensa se rinde tras los tres goles
articles.summary: Luis Díaz volvió a firmar una de esas actuaciones memorables que reafirman su estatus en el fútbol europeo. Con un magistral hat-trick frente al RB Leipzig, el guajiro lideró la goleada del Bayern Múnich y despertó la admiración unánime tanto de la prensa alemana como de sus propios compañeros de plantilla y directivos.
articles.body: Luis Díaz volvió a firmar una de esas actuaciones memorables que reafirman su estatus en el fútbol europeo. Con un magistral hat-trick frente al RB Leipzig, el guajiro lideró la goleada del Bayern Múnich y despertó la admiración unánime tanto de la prensa alemana como de sus propios compañeros de plantilla y directivos. Uno de los más efusivos al término del compromiso fue Joshua Kimmich. El referente y volante del conjunto bávaro, quien asistió a 'Lucho' para abrir el marcador a los 12 minutos, no escatimó en elogios para calificar el despliegue del colombiano. "Estoy muy contento por Lucho. Se lo merecía totalmente. Falló algunas ocasiones al inicio de la temporada después de haber tenido un rendimiento increíble la campaña pasada. Hoy jugó un partido excepcional y sin duda fue el mejor del encuentro", declaró Kimmich en entrevista para Sky Sport. Kimmich explicó detalladamente cómo el juego de desmarque de Luis Díaz simplifica la labor de los mediocampistas a la hora de filtrar balones a la espalda de la zaga rival: "Siempre intento mantener la cabeza alta y mirar hacia adelante. Con Lucho tenemos un jugador que siempre está dispuesto a hacer esos desmarques. Eso es muy importante... Por eso creamos tantas oportunidades de gol. Lucho estuvo sensacional hoy". El rotativo alemán Bild respaldó la visión del futbolista teutón otorgándole a Díaz la calificación más alta (1), catalogándolo como "el jugador más destacado de un equipo excepcionalmente fuerte". Con esta presentación, el guajiro alcanzó los 31 goles en 61 partidos oficiales defendiendo la camiseta del Bayern. Por su parte, el director deportivo del club, Max Eberl, también resaltó el momento en el que llega esta exhibición de Díaz, especialmente considerando los compromisos decisivos que se avecinan en el plano internacional, como el choque ante el Arsenal en la UEFA Champions League donde no podrán contar con Michael Olise. Eberl destacó además que las dos semanas de receso en las que no estuvo con la Selección Colombia le permitieron recuperar frescura física y mental para alcanzar nuevamente su mejor versión. Con este brillante triplete, Luis Díaz no solo despeja cualquier duda sobre su momento futbolístico, sino que consolida su rol como pieza inamovible en el esquema ofensivo del Bayern Múnich.

images.caption: Kimmich se rinde al partidazo y triplete de Luis Díaz en el Bayern.

articles.title: Mbappé se pica con Lamine y firma su mejor gol con el Real Madrid
articles.standfirst: Obra de arte del francés en el 2-0 del Madrid para 'responder' al azulgrana
articles.summary: Obra de arte del francés en el 2-0 del Madrid para 'responder' al azulgrana
articles.body: Un día después de que Lamine Yamal firmara ante el Betis un gol que dio la vuelta al mundo, llegó el turno de réplica de Mbappé. El francés aceptó el reto del azulgrana y marcó ante el Sevilla el que hasta hora puede ser su mejor gol con el Real Madrid. Kylian agarró el balón en la frontal del área tras un taconazo de Bellingham, regateó a su marcador con un giro casi completo en el control y se pasó el balón de un pie a otro para sortear la salida del meta del Sevilla. Todo ello aderezado por la potencia y velocidad que el 10 madridista imprime a cada una de sus acciones. Una jugada llena de vértigo y talento que puso al Bernabéu en pie y que entra de lleno en las obras de arte que va dejando la Liga. En el apasionante duelo que mantienen Mbappé y Lamine por ser considerados el mejor jugador del mundo, las estrellas de Real Madrid y Barcelona están sacando su mejor versión, con el Balón de Oro pendiente de conocer su ganador tras cerrarse ya las votaciones. Y todo ello a una semana de que se vean las caras en el Clásico, donde serán los grandes protagonistas del duelo. Aparte de la extraordinaria espectacularidad de la jugada, al mérito del gol se le añade la importancia que tuvo para encarrilar el marcador ante el Sevilla. Mbappé hacía el 2-0 para poner tierra de por medio en un partido vital para el Real Madrid en su objetivo de no ceder más puntos tras las victorias de Barcelona y Atlético el sábado. Eso en el primer tiempo, porque en el segundo firmó el doblete tras marcar el 3-0 de penalti. Él se lo guisó y él se lo comió. Es el undécimo gol de la temporada para Mbappé en 11 partidos, para un total de 97, que lo acercan a los 100 tantos oficiales con el Real Madrid en apenas dos temporadas y media como madridista. A los 11 goles, Mbappé suma dos asistencias, lo que deja su impacto ofensivo en 13 acciones de valor gol.

articles.title: Kike Salas: "Es expulsión clara"
articles.standfirst: El Sevilla señala el codazo de Güler a Peque; el turco no fue amonestado ni se revisó la jugada
articles.summary: El Sevilla señala el codazo de Güler a Peque; el turco no fue amonestado ni se revisó la jugada
articles.body: El Sevilla se ha marchado al descanso perdiendo 2-0 en el Bernabéu frente al Real Madrid con polémica incluida. Con los blancos atacando, Peque y Arda Güler entraron en una disputa sin balón y el turco terminó quitándose de encima al sevillista con un codazo. El madridista no fue amonestado ni la acción fue revisada. Más adelante, Güler marcó el primer tanto para el conjunto local. Kike Salas atendió a los micrófonos de Movistar en el descanso y fue claro: "Teníamos el partido controlado pero esa acción viene de un codazo que parece que es expulsión clara, pero ahí no podemos entrar. Esos detalles marcan la diferencia. Peque dice que le da un codazo y él no se va a tirar al suelo y a pedir las asistencias, confío en mi jugador, ahora lo miraré, no ha intervenido ni siquiera para verlo. Dos detalles que han tenido ellos han marcado la diferencia". El Sevilla, en su cuenta oficial de X, publicó: "Claro codazo de Güler sobre Peque que se salda con amarilla para Huijsen y Félix". El primero por tirarle del brazo al catalán para ponerle en pie y el blanquirrojo por protestar. No fue la única jugada que levantó a los sevillistas del banquillo. En el minuto 36 Kylian Mbappé haría el segundo gol del Real Madrid y el Sevilla pidió una falta previa sobre Robbie Ure, pero Busquets Ferrer tampoco invalidó el tanto ni fue avisado para que revisara la jugada. "Hemos estado en el partido, lo hemos intentado. Se ha decidido por decisiones que se han tomado", comentaba Juan Iglesias al finalizar el encuentro. "La acción de Peque es una agresión, lo hemos visto en el descanso. Y en otro gol de ellos es una falta a Robbie que no han repetido en televisión. Sabíamos a lo que veníamos. Hacer autocrítica también, pero hay decisiones que no han salido de nuestra parte y eso hay que valorarlo también", añadía. El lateral, que vio una tarjeta amarilla en la segunda parte, concluía refiriéndose a los árbitros: "Muchas veces no se puede hablar con ellos, no te lo permiten: que te vayas, que te saco tarjeta... es lo fácil siempre. Pero veníamos aquí y sabíamos cómo iba a ser todo".

articles.title: La Lazio de Gattuso va en serio: golea en Turín y es colíder junto al Inter
articles.standfirst: Tremendo triunfo de los romanos ante la Juventus, donde ya se discute a Spaletti
articles.summary: Tremendo triunfo de los romanos ante la Juventus, donde ya se discute a Spaletti
articles.body: Esta Lazio del técnico Gennaro Gattuso va muy en serio, como demostró este domingo goleando a la mismísima Juventus en Turín (0-3) en un incontestable partido de principio a fin. Los tantos de Provstgaard, en la primera mitad, y los de Isaksen y Dele-Bashiru, cuando ya agonizaba el partido, dieron a la Lazio los tres puntos y posibilitó que los laziales se coloquen segundos, con los mismos puntos que el Inter, vigente campeón, tras las primeras siete jornadas jugadas. La Roma es tercera a dos puntos de los líderes. La Lazio alineó al español Pedraza, ex del Villarreal, si bien apenas jugó los últimos cinco minutos en sustitución de Zaccagni. El triunfo se basó en un claro dominio del juego, dejando muy pocas 'chances' a una Juventus que, eso sí, le fue anulado un gol, aún con 0-0, por fuera de juego. Lo había marcado Kolo Muani. La Lazio demuestra que la Serie A está más abierta que nunca y que los equipos romanos, Lazio y Roma, le pueden hacerle sombra este año al gran favorito, que es el Inter. Con esta derrota, la Juve se queda octava en la tabla y el entrenador Luciano Spaletti sigue siendo muy discutido en las filas turinesas.

articles.title: Tebas: "¿La pancarta también es una opinión ajena al Real Madrid?"
articles.standfirst: El preisdente de LaLiga reacciona al mensaje mostrado este domingo en el Bernabéu
articles.summary: El preisdente de LaLiga reacciona al mensaje mostrado este domingo en el Bernabéu
articles.body: El presidente de LaLiga, Javier Tebas, reaccionó a la pancarta mostrada en el fondo sur del Bernabéu durante el partido de este domingo, en la que se podía leer el mensaje: "No es fútbol, son Tebas y Negreira". "¿También van a explicarlo como una opinión ajena al club",. se preguntaba el presidente de LaLiga en una publicación en X. El texto íntegro del mensaje de Tebas es el siguiente: "Han bastado dos días para que los hechos me vayan dando la razón. En mi post del 16 de octubre, señalé a Tomás González-Martín, de El Debate, como portaCOZ del discurso de la dirección del Real Madrid. El club respondió ese mismo 16 de octubre con un comunicado escudándose en las opiniones de «periodistas ajenos al club», sobre las que decía no tener responsabilidad. En mi respuesta del 16 de octubre, les pedí algo muy concreto: que desmintieran la comparación con Negreira que el periodista atribuía a fuentes del club y las acusaciones de que LaLiga les perjudica con los horarios. Que publicaran todas sus solicitudes de cambios y cuántas habían sido atendidas. TODO el balance, incluidas las peticiones aceptadas que estropean el relato de la persecución. Este 18 de octubre, Real Madrid TV vuelve a cargar contra mí y su grada de animación, coordinada y supervisada por el club, despliega una pancarta: «No es fútbol, son Tebas y Negreira». ¿También van a explicarlo como una opinión ajena al club? La coincidencia con el relato que denuncié está a la vista. Y hay algo especialmente grave: poner a personas concretas en la diana. En mi post del 16 de octubre ya recordé aquella frase: «Te pondré en contra a toda la afición del Real Madrid y no podrás ir por la calle». Lo ocurrido este 18 de octubre refuerza mi denuncia sobre ese intento de convertir las discrepancias con sus dirigentes en hostilidad de la afición contra una persona. Señalar, desacreditar y alimentar esa hostilidad es una enorme irresponsabilidad. Los dirigentes tienen la obligación de comprender las consecuencias de los mensajes que promueven y amplifican. Y otro ejemplo: su publicación del 17 de octubre sobre «la prensa internacional» . Las informaciones de Reuters, BBC o L’Équipe... que el propio Madrid reproduce cuentan que quien la pide es el Real Madrid. Convertir la cobertura de su exigencia en respaldo a esa exigencia es manipular. Basta leer su propia publicación para comprobarlo, como señalé en otro post. La dirección del Real Madrid se ha instalado en la manipulación y la falsedad, también en sus comunicados y publicaciones oficiales. Alimentan el agravio, repiten las acusaciones, ponen personas en la diana y después se presentan como víctimas cuando se denuncia el procedimiento. Pueden seguir pidiendo mi dimisión. Las preguntas sobre sus fuentes, sus acusaciones y los horarios siguen pendientes desde el 16 de octubre. Cada día ilustran mejor lo que denuncié".

articles.title: 'Four points is nothing' - Celtic manager Martin O'Neill stays cool after statement win over Hearts
articles.summary: Amid supporter discontent, a recent protest against the major shareholder and a veteran manager deciding now is not the time to "wrap things up", as Martin O'Neill put it, you'd be forgiven for scratching your head when examining Celtic's current domestic situation.
articles.body:
With ongoing supporter discontent, a recent tennis ball protest against the major shareholder on a golf course and a veteran manager deciding now is not the time to "wrap things up", as Martin O'Neill put it, you'd be forgiven for scratching your head when examining Celtic's current domestic situation.

They sit four points clear at the top of the Scottish Premiership. Five, really, if you factor in a goal difference at present 12 better than nearest challengers Rangers.

All this off the back of a 7-1 demolition of last season's runners-up, Hearts, who - at least until they turned up at Celtic Park - were widely viewed as viable title contenders if there's to be another three-way fight for Scottish football's main prize.

Has normal service been restored in the east end of Glasgow after the wobbles of four significant defeats in their past half-dozen? Not as far as their wily old manager is concerned.

Keen to stress that the road is yet long to the division's ultimate destination, O'Neill was full of smiles after his side's biggest win since he returned last year, but he didn't even accept that such a thrashing of the third-placed side in the division was even a 'statement' victory.

"I'm not really sure about that," O'Neill told BBC Scotland.

"We're eight or nine games into the season or whatever it is.

"It was nice to win and win in the manner we did as well. We scored some really great goals. We looked really good going forward and I thought, defensively, the back four did really well for us when we were under pressure.

"But I think they were helped by the players in front of them as well too, so overall it was very, very pleasing."

So, just how good a Celtic performance was this?

As far as former Rangers striker Kris Boyd is concerned, it was a throwback to Parkhead's favourite Australian, whose fast-flowing, attacking football delivered a domestic double followed by a treble in his two seasons in charge, prior to Brendan Rodgers' return.

"That is the closest I've seen to Ange Postecoglou's Celtic," Boyd told Sky Sports.

Former Hearts defender Ryan McGowan felt his old side simply ran into Celtic at the wrong time.

"It's a really poor performance from Hearts," McGowan said on Sky Sports.

"At the same time, you've got to give Celtic credit. It was probably their best performance of the season."

Celtic showed more cohesion and spirit than in recent performances, according to former goalkeeper Pat Bonner, who feels two youngsters shone particularly brightly in the October sunshine.

"Celtic's organisation was better," Bonner told BBC Radio Scotland's Sportsound.

"They worked harder as a unit. Their attitude was better, everybody doing that little bit of hard graft that you have to do and then ability takes over.

"Young Callum Osmand and Colby Donovan, they're the ones that set the tone."

Former Celtic captain Scott Brown summed up his old side's performance in one word: "Fantastic."

And he added: "The best thing about Celtic today was the pace in the forward line and how they got after Hearts. Camilo Duran through the middle is exciting me.

"Callum Osmand did more in 45 minutes out wide than Sebastian Tounekti has done probably since he signed for the club. Haissem Hassan has got a few issues defensively but going forward he's a delight to watch."

The front four of Osmand, Benjamin Nygren, Hassan and Duran caused Hearts no end of problems.

A double for the young striker, a double for the Sweden international who's now on eight for the season from midfield well before Halloween, a goal and two assists from the consistently impressive Colombian, and one of the Egypt winger's best displays since signing after the World Cup. Is this then the template going forward? Not necessarily, according to their manager.

"No, because we've got so many matches coming up in Europe and in the league," O'Neill explained.

"We're going Sunday, Thursday, Sunday, Thursday, Sunday, Thursday. So, we will have to mix it up a little bit. It's also a squad game for us at this stage. Between now and the beginning of January we are at it constantly."

As if to illustrate his point, Celtic's next fixture comes under the 'must-win' category as Celta Vigo come calling in Thursday's Europa League fixture, with both sides yet to register a point in the league phase after two defeats each.

"We'll make a couple of adjustments on Thursday evening," O'Neill said.

"We still want to try and win and I think other players coming on and getting little bits of games here and there helps immensely. It helps the whole squad and I think it helps the confidence of the team.

"It will be a tough game for us. Celta Vigo are a team in a big league in Spain, they're very, very decent, but it's a game we probably have to win.

"We have to win to give ourselves some momentum and do some catching up because we've lost two games, so we really need to win this game. We'll go all out to try and do it."

Celtic score seven in humiliation of title rivals Hearts

Hearts roll out red carpet... and Celtic walk all over it

All the latest Celtic news, views and analysis

Will Celtic take some catching from here?

O'Neill, fresh from the memory of two recent defeats by arch rivals Rangers, knows there is many a slip between cup and lip when it comes to the Premiership rollercoaster.

"Four points at this stage of the season is absolutely nothing," he stressed.

"I thought the team did really well. We got the goals, which seemed to match the performance, which was really nice. It's not too often you get a scoreline like that. So, we'll enjoy it this evening."

It was all summed up rather nicely by one of O'Neill's favoured sons when he was manager first time around between 2000 and 2005 - Henrik Larsson's strike partner, Chris Sutton.

"It's a strange old season for Celtic," Sutton told Sky Sports.

"Domestically, they've been flying, but in Europe it just hasn't been there. Good to see Jota back. What a contribution Callum Osmand made. Will this result lead on to more confidence in Europe?"

With Celta Vigo turning up in midweek, everyone associated with Celtic will certainly hope so.

articles.title: Militao, 180 días después
articles.standfirst: El central reaparece ante el Sevilla medio año después de romperse el tendón proximal del bíceps femoral izquierdo frente al Alavés
articles.summary: El central reaparece ante el Sevilla medio año después de romperse el tendón proximal del bíceps femoral izquierdo frente al Alavés
articles.body: Ciento ochenta días caben en un calendario, pero no en la cabeza de quien los cuenta desde la enfermería. Ese es el tiempo exacto que Éder Militao ha tardado en volver a pisar el Santiago Bernabéu para sentirse futbolista. Este domingo, ante el Sevilla, el central brasileño reapareció medio año después de su última caída, y lo hizo en su primer partido a las órdenes de José Mourinho. El Bernabéu no esperó al cambio para abrazarlo. Bastó que Militao se levantara del banquillo y empezara a calentar por la banda para que algún sector del estadio se pusiera en pie. Una ovación cálida, de las que reconocen el mérito que hay detrás del sufrimiento, recibió al defensa en el momento de volver a vestirse de corto junto a sus compañeros. El reencuentro completo llegó en el minuto 84, tras el gol de Diomande, cuando Militao saltó al césped en relevo de Valverde. Esta vez no fue un sector, sino todo Chamartín el que se rindió a su regreso con una ovación unánime. Su calvario tiene nombre técnico y fecha. Fue el pasado abril, frente al Alavés, cuando el tendón proximal del bíceps femoral de su pierna izquierda dijo basta. Se operó pocos días después en Finlandia, de la mano de Lasse Lempainen, el mismo cirujano que ya lo había guiado antes, y el quirófano le arrebató el verano y el Mundial con Brasil. Medio año de gimnasio, de paciencia y de espera para llegar hasta la noche de hoy. Nadie en Valdebebas ha olvidado el currículum de cicatrices que acompaña al brasileño. Antes del bíceps femoral, la rodilla izquierda cedió en noviembre de 2024; un año y pico antes, la derecha, en agosto de 2023. Dos cruzados en dos cursos consecutivos, un peaje que pocos futbolistas pagan en toda una carrera y que Militao ha afrontado sin bajar los brazos. Mourinho, que apenas lleva unos meses en el banquillo, se estrena así con un Militao sano, un jugador al que había visto crecer en los entrenamientos y al que, según confesó él mismo, frenaba cada día para evitar prisas. Ahora, el central vuelve a sumarse a una defensa que lo esperaba con muchas ganas.

articles.title: Curro Sánchez hace justicia para un Burgos que perdonó demasiado
articles.standfirst: Decidió el encuentro con un penalti que le paró Fuoli a la primera, pero no a la segunda
articles.summary: Decidió el encuentro con un penalti que le paró Fuoli a la primera, pero no a la segunda
articles.body: El Burgos encontró el premio a su insistencia para superar al Sabadell en El Plantío y reencontrarse así con las victorias tras dos derrotas seguidas. Un penalti transformado por Curro Sánchez al segundo intento decidió un encuentro en el que los blanquinegros acumularon ocasiones suficientes para haber resuelto el partido mucho antes. Karrikaburu se topó con la defensa visitante, Galdames estrelló un balón en el larguero y Fuoli sostuvo con varias intervenciones de mérito a un equipo arlequinado que ofreció muy poco en ataque y pierde su segundo partido liguero, cortando su buena racha de cuatro jornadas sumando. El Sabadell arrancó con una presión adelantada y trató de incomodar la salida de balón local, pero el Burgos pronto encontró la manera de superar esa primera línea. Muy pronto Karrikaburu desperdició una gran oportunidad tras un centro medido de Llabrés que no acertó a dirigir de cabeza entre los tres palos. El delantero volvió a encontrarse con Fuoli poco después en un centro de Appin y dos minutos más tarde fue Grego Sierra quien obligó al guardameta a intervenir antes de que el balón golpeara en el larguero. Los locales insistieron hasta el descanso, aunque sin premio. Karrikaburu volvió a reclamar protagonismo en el tiempo añadido, cuando remató un centro de Lizancos que terminó rechazado por Catalá. Entre medias, el Burgos reclamó la expulsión de Quadri por derribar al 7 local cuando se disponía a encarar al portero. Además, la primera parte dejó también la lesión de David González, sustituido tras haber disputado todos los minutos del equipo hasta entonces La segunda mitad comenzó con otro contratiempo: Appin tuvo que abandonar el terreno de juego por lesión y Dadie entró en su lugar. El guion, sin embargo, apenas cambió. Karrikaburu volvió a quedarse a centímetros del gol al rematar un córner en el segundo palo que Urri sacó prácticamente bajo la línea y Galdames tuvo todo a favor para marcar, pero su disparo acabó estrellándose en el larguero. El momento decisivo llegó justo a la hora de partido cuando Catalá golpeó a Curro Sánchez en una acción sobre el límite del área y el árbitro señaló penalti. Fuoli detuvo el primer lanzamiento del capitán burgalés, pero la pena máxima tuvo que repetirse a instancias del VAR porque Catalá pisaba la frontal del área y acabó despejando. Y en el segundo intento, Curro Sánchez cambió la dirección del disparo y no perdonó para establecer el 1-0 que sería definitivo. El Burgos pudo sentenciar cuatro minutos después, cuando Karrikaburu dejó a Llabrés solo ante Fuoli con un cabezazo, pero el atacante no logró ampliar la ventaja. El Sabadell ganó presencia en el tramo final, aunque el conjunto local consiguió mantener el control sin conceder ocasiones a los visitantes y volviendo a sonreír tras dos derrotas consecutivas.

articles.title: La Real ya es quinta en LaLiga
articles.standfirst: El equipo txuriurdin sigue su escalada desde la tercera jornada, consiguiendo 16 de los últimos 21 puntos, y supera al Sevilla, tras su derrota en el Bernabéu
articles.summary: El equipo txuriurdin sigue su escalada desde la tercera jornada, consiguiendo 16 de los últimos 21 puntos, y supera al Sevilla, tras su derrota en el Bernabéu
articles.body: La Real Sociedad ha continuado en esta novena jornada con la gran ascensión en la clasificación que está protagonizando desde la segunda, cuando era colista tras dos derrotas, y ya se ha situado en la quinta posición, después de hacerse con 16 de los últimos 21 puntos en juego, el tercer equipo que más como reflejamos en MARCA hace unos días ya lo era antes de este fin de semana, sólo por detrás del Barcelona y el Atlético de Madrid. La Real ha aprovechado enfrentarse al colista Málaga para hacerse con un nuevo triunfo, el quinto en las siete fechas más recientes, no ganando en esta ocasión ni el Betis, uno de los seis equipos que tenía por encima, ni el Sevilla, que era quinto, por lo que le supera y accede a esa gran posición. Y de los equipos que tenía por detrás, no han vencido ni Deportivo Alavés, ni Deportivo de A Coruña, ni Athletic de Bilbao, ni Villarreal, ni Espanyol, por lo que es uno de los equipos más beneficiados del fin de semana. Además, en estas siete jornadas en las que ha sumado 16 puntos, gracias a cinco victorias, un empate y una sola derrota, rivales en la pelea por Europa se han hecho con menos botín, como el Villarreal que ha logrado nueve puntos menos, el Sevilla ocho, el Athletic siete y el Celta seis, por decir algunos.

articles.title: Driver released without charges after pickup kills boy, 6, and man on Kansas soccer field
articles.summary: A 6-year-old boy and a 35-year-old man were killed when a pickup truck drove onto a Wichita soccer field, injuring 10 others including children.
articles.body: The driver of a pickup truck that plowed onto a Kansas soccer field, killing a young boy and a man, has been released without charges as investigators work to determine what turned a Saturday afternoon of youth sports into tragedy. Wichita police announced Sunday that the 34-year-old woman was released pending toxicology results and a mechanical examination of her Chevrolet pickup. Authorities also identified those killed as Cole Adrian, 6, and Nicholas Schafer, 35, both of McPherson, Kansas. They were not related. Five children were among the 10 people injured when the truck drove from a parking space onto a field at Stryker Sports Complex at about 3:25 p.m. Saturday, police said. WE ARE LOOKING AT YOUTH SPORTS ALL WRONG AND THAT CAN LEAD TO INJURIES AND BURNOUT The woman, who was initially taken into custody, had two of her children inside the pickup. Another of her children was playing soccer on a different field at the complex. Her release followed interviews with more than 30 witnesses, including the children inside the truck, and consultation with the Sedgwick County District Attorney’s Office, according to police. SUPPORTERS OF ALABAMA SCHOOL BUS DRIVER CHARGED IN DEADLY ACCIDENT SAY SHE SUFFERED FROM 'MEDICAL CRISIS' Investigators have not determined what caused the deadly crash. Authorities have not confirmed whether it was intentional or whether a medical emergency, impairment or another factor was involved. The district attorney’s office told Fox News Digital that police are expected to make an initial case presentation to District Attorney Marc Bennett early this week. CAR PLOWS INTO PEDESTRIAN ZONE KILLING 2 AS POLICE DETAIN DRIVER AND INVESTIGATE MOTIVE "Following that initial case review, our office will share information as appropriate," the office said. The crash sent emergency crews racing to the sports complex in northeast Wichita, where bystanders had already stepped forward to help the injured. Adrian and Schafer died on the field despite lifesaving efforts. FLORIDA STUDENT KILLED IN ROLLOVER SCHOOL BUS CRASH Ten people were taken to Ascension Via Christi and Wesley Medical Center with injuries police described Sunday as noncritical. The injured children included a 5-year-old girl, a 5-year-old boy, two 8-year-old boys and a 9-year-old girl. The five injured adults ranged in age from 28 to 68. An additional woman, 61, was hospitalized for medical complications unrelated to traumatic injuries, bringing the total number transported to 11. Sporting Wichita Academy said the tragedy had shaken a soccer community built around families and teammates, thanking first responders, medical workers and bystanders who stepped in to help. "Soccer is more than a game. It is a community. It is families in the stands, teammates standing beside one another, and people who come together through a shared love of the game," the academy wrote on Facebook. "Today, that community is hurting, and we must lean on one another more than ever." As investigators search for answers, a restaurant is stepping in to help grieving families and those with loved ones in the hospital. Meddys pledged to donate 20% of all revenue from its Wichita and Salina locations from Oct. 18 through Oct. 24 to families affected by the tragedy. The business also offered free meals to the immediate families of those injured for as long as their loved ones remain hospitalized. "With so much to carry right now, figuring out your next meal should not have to be one more worry," Meddys wrote on Facebook. The restaurant partnered with local nonprofit Kingdom Athletics Mission to receive and distribute donations to the affected McPherson families after people outside the area asked how they could help. Meddys said the nonprofit would manage both GoFundMe donations and the business’ contributions. "Wichita is our home. These are our neighbors. In moments like this, we take care of one another," the business wrote. PANTHERS GREAT JONATHAN STEWART EXPLAINS WHY YOUTH SPORTS MATTER FAR BEYOND THE FIELD Wichita Police Chief Joe Sullivan also offered condolences to the families Sunday. "What should have been a day of children playing soccer and families spending time together ended in tragedy," he said. "We are also thinking about those who were injured, their loved ones and everyone who witnessed what happened. We know this tragedy has affected many people throughout our community, and we want those families to know they are not alone." The deadly crash also halted the Kansas State High School Activities Association’s inaugural girls flag football state championship, which was taking place on an adjacent field. The association suspended play and said games would not resume that weekend. At Saturday’s news conference, Wichita Police Capt. Aaron Moses said the driver had a valid license, no outstanding arrest warrants and was cooperating with investigators. Sullivan underscored the unanswered question confronting investigators. "We know what happened, but now we’re working very hard to find out why it happened," he said Saturday. articles.title: El Bernabéu no echó de menos a Vinicius
articles.standfirst: La opinión de José Vicente Hernáez
articles.summary: La opinión de José Vicente Hernáez
articles.body: Tiene permiso Mbappé para no ayudar en defensa a recuperar balones. Al menos el mío. Lo suyo es que juegue como él quiere, tal como lo hace. Porque resulta que cuando baja a defender puede perder un balón cerca del área y el rival te mete un gol. Eso es lo que sucedió en el minuto 80. El Madrid estaba tocándose las narices, disfrutando del 3-0 que señalaba el marcador, sin pisar el acelerador. No le hacía falta, pero una cosa es que no le hiciera falta y otra muy distinta que el rival se le suba a la chepa. Total, que Mbappé, que se aburría de no ver un balón, bajó a echar una mano, la pifió y a Courtois le hicieron un gol. Total, que lo mejor es que Mbappé se quede arriba esperando que le pongan un buen balón, como el que le puso Diomande a la hora de partido. Se fue por velocidad y le hicieron penalti. Un penalti dudosillo, de esos que se pitan y de los penaltis que si no se pitan se queja luego todo el mundo. Lo que ocurre es que cuando no defiende más de uno llegan los problemas. Esta vez no hubo tantos porque Diomande echó una mano a Cucurella durante todo el partido, hasta el punto de que el Bernabéu no echó de menos en absoluto a Vinicius. Porque Diomande, además de su trabajo defensivo, dio a Mbappé el pase que acabó siendo el 3-0 y después, en el minuto 82, dejó sentenciado el partido con un golazo desde el borde del área. Hizo bien Mourinho en no cambiarlo. No acertó, en cambio, en meter a Endrick en el once titular, sin duda para agradecerle que le sacase de un marrón en Roma de proporciones gigantescas. Hacía dos temporadas que Endrick no era titular en Liga, en un partido ante el Mallorca en el Bernabéu. No lo acabó tampoco. Un Bernabéu, por cierto, que dedicó una ovación a Arda Güler al ser sustituído. Elemental, querido Watson, que diría el amigo Sherlock.

articles.body: Luis García Plaza comparecía tras la derrota frente al Real Madrid en la sala de prensa del Santiago Bernabéu. "Codazo y se acabó" es el titular de la crónica del partido en la web oficial del Sevilla. "Espero que lo tituléis todos así, no solo la web del Sevilla. Un partido es once contra once, pero nos han privado de jugar el partido once contra diez. En la Liga a veces juegas partidos en superioridad o inferioridad y hoy nos tocaba hacerlo en superioridad. Tenemos que jugar once contra diez desde el minuto 25. Es increíble. En el descanso estaba diciendo "que me ha pegado, que me ha pegado". Es roja. A partir de ahí podemos decir lo que sea. Y hay una falta a Robbie. No es roja pero es falta. Con 0-0 teníamos que jugar 65 minutos once contra diez. Es el resumen del partido, no sabemos qué hubiera pasado". El técnico insistía: "Me han dicho que no se ha visto la jugada de Robbie en televisión pero es muy clara. A lo mejor no ganamos porque el Madrid es capaz de ganarlo con diez. Me pasó con el Alavés porque son muy buenos, pero nos han privado de esa situación. Es otro partido el que se tenía que haber jugado. Llevamos tres en inferioridad y dos en superioridad y este era otro que nos tocaba". "¿Que por qué no han avisado desde el VAR? Igual no querían que hubiera más distancia de puntos para el Clásico si ganábamos”, añadía.

articles.title: Mourinho cambia los pies del Madrid
articles.standfirst: La opinión de Santiago Siguero
articles.summary: La opinión de Santiago Siguero
articles.body: Movió Mourinho el once y el equipo lo agradeció. Juntó en el once inicial a varios futbolistas con buen pie y el Madrid, sin llegar a ser un torrente de fútbol, fluyó con más suavidad que en el infame primer tiempo de Roma, sin ir más lejos. La decisión más importante del entrenador fue retrasar a Fede Valverde al lateral derecho, lo que quitó un problema del centro del campo (su pareja con Tchouaméni no funciona) y aportó una solución en la salida del balón. Fede no es Kroos, pero tampoco es cojo, y además la banda le ofrece el mejor contexto para su gran virtud, que no es el toque, sino la potencia al espacio. Si Mou consigue convencerlo de que puede ser protagonista desde la banda, el equipo lo va a agradecer. Aunque el mejor pie del Madrid volvió a ser el de Güler, que suplió a Fede en el eje. El turco es la llave que abre casi todas las puertas en este Madrid, que depende casi dolorosamente de su talento para crear fútbol. A la espera de que Bernardo y sus piernaslleguen a Valdebebas, Arda es innegociable en este equipo, aunque sea en una posición más alejada del área. Abrió la lata con un espectacular zurdazo poco después de comprar papeletas para una intervención del VAR que, en este caso, no se produjo. Ir a Barcelona sin Güler y Vini, expulsado la semana pasada por una acción asimilable, hubiera sido cianuro para el Madrid, que en cualquier caso llega apuradísimo a la cita. Tiene argumentos, claro. Diomandé es un demonio en el uno contra uno, pero no acaba de atinar con el pase definitivo. Bellingham es un obseso del despliegue, Huijsen está volviendo al modo unicornio de sus primeros meses de blanco. Y Mbappé, claro. Su primer gol de anoche fue un homenaje a los controles increíbles de Bergkamp, un movimiento de bailarín y una definición a la altura. Y está Güler, claro. El turco con pelazo de telenovela que alimenta la ilusión del madridismo, hambriento de fe de un tiempo (ya demasiado largo) a esta parte.

articles.title: American Conference explains why UTSA game vs. Navy was played following Air Force officer's fatal fall during rappelling demo
articles.summary: Nellis Air Force Base confirmed the officer's death early Sunday morning.
articles.body:
The American Conference released a statement Sunday explaining why UTSA's game against Navy proceeded after a slight delay following an Air Force officer's fatal fall from the rafters during a pregame rappelling demonstration.

Nellis Air Force Base confirmed the unidentified officer's death early Sunday morning. Saturday night's game at the Alamodome was UTSA's military tribute night and featured military members rappelling from the building's ceiling.

The Air Force officer plunged from near the top of the scoreboard and violently landed on the field. He was immediately tended to by medical personnel, driven off the field on a cart and taken to a local hospital.

Sunday afternoon, the conference said that it held discussions with multiple entities over the course of the evening, but that the service member's condition was unknown during the game.

During the game, representatives of both participating member institutions, Alamodome management and local authorities met with American Conference Commissioner Tim Pernetti and a working group to review the information available and discuss next steps. At the time of those discussions, Nellis Air Force Base Public Affairs had not publicly confirmed the service member's condition.

Air Force casualty notification and information-release procedures establish safeguards for notifying families and publicly releasing casualty information. In accordance with conference bylaws and with the support of both participating member institutions, the conference made the decision to continue the game. Respect for the family's privacy and adherence to the military's notification process guided the decision to mitigate speculation about the service member's medical status and avoid additional distress for his family. Later, at 11:40 p.m. Eastern time, Nellis Air Force Base Public Affairs confirmed that the service member had been injured during the pregame demonstration and transported to a local hospital, where he later died. We are grateful to the first responders and emergency personnel who provided immediate care on the field. Our hearts and prayers are with everyone impacted by this tragedy. We know this has been difficult for everyone involved. Per Nellis Air Force Base, the details surrounding his death are under investigation, and we have been asked to respect the privacy of the airman's family, loved ones and teammates during this difficult time.

We know this has been difficult for everyone involved. Per Nellis Air Force Base, the details surrounding his death are under investigation, and we have been asked to respect the privacy of the airman's family, loved ones and teammates during this difficult time.

UTSA won the game 38-34. In his postgame news conference, UTSA coach Jeff Traylor noted how somber the Alamodome crowd was at kickoff. There was an audible noise of horror from those who were in the stands at the time when the officer fell.

"There was something — you could just tell that the energy was just gone," Traylor said. "I've never had to deal with anything like that before. It just puts things in perspective. It really does."

articles.title: Paul Finebaum blasts Steve Sarkisian after another rough Arch Manning performance
articles.summary: ESPN's Paul Finebaum didn't hold back on Texas head coach Steve Sarkisian on "The Matt Barrie Show."
articles.body:
A week after losing to Oklahoma as the No. 1 team in the country, Texas lost at home to Florida as the No. 7 team in the nation.

Quarterback Arch Manning struggled at the end of the Oklahoma game, throwing two interceptions in the fourth quarter, and those struggles carried over into the Texas game.

He didn't see the field well on Saturday and fumbled at the end of the game, helping Florida pull off the upset.

ESPN's Paul Finebaum watched how it all played out and went after Texas head coach Steve Sarkisian for the way that Manning has played on "The Matt Barrie Show."

Paul Finebaum, radio and ESPN television personality, gets ready to speak on television near activities outside the Superdome, before of the College Football Playoff National Championship game in New Orleans Monday, January 13, 2020. Pregame Fans Clemson Lsu Football Cfp National Championship New Orleans Credit: USA TODAY Network via Reuters Connect (Reuters)

"I have no earthly idea what Steve Sarkisian is doing. I think we all agree that he shouldn't be calling the plays," Finebaum said . "There's too many other things going on on that sideline that are distracting. He has made an absolute mess out of the most talented team in the country. I'll wait a week before we make any declarations because they have the capability to beat anyone as we know, but what a disaster."

"The absolute arrogance of Sarkisian to crack back at people like me and others who dared to criticize Arch Manning with the idiotic take of the year that if his name was Joe Smith, you would be praising him. His name is Arch Manning. It always has been and I'm beginning to wonder if Arch Manning should even start against Ole Miss. I know he will and he's capable of leading them to a win, but I blame Sarkisian for every aspect of this."

Texas will return to the field next Saturday at home against Ole Miss. Kickoff will be at 7:30 p.m. ET.
